title: Read-only Blender 5.2 localization of the B62 close-shot obstruction
question: Does the rejected CLOSE_REFLECTION calibration frame have a reproducible geometric near-occlusion signature that is absent from the WIDE_APPROACH and MEDIUM_CONTACT controls?

measurements: evaluated camera transform, lens, sensor and clipping planes
per-grid-ray first-hit object, semantic group and distance
near-field first-hit share and median hit distance
exact-target visibility ray for each semantic anchor bounding-box center
character evaluated-vertex projected union bounds and on-screen vertex fraction
design.primaryAndIndependentImplementations: Two fresh Blender processes use separate Python files. Neither imports the other. Both must produce exact integer grid counts, exact first-hit object rosters, and floating measurements within 1e-9 absolute tolerance.

diagnosticSignature.controlsRequired: Neither readable control may satisfy all three close-required conditions.
diagnosticSignature.scope: These thresholds localize this already-observed failure. They are not a general cinematic-quality threshold and cannot be promoted unchanged to the later holdout.

sequence: Commit and push this exact spec and protocol before any required tool exists.
Implement and statically validate all four tools while the formal root remains absent.
Commit and push exact tool bytes; the runner requires HEAD equals origin/main and a clean scoped worktree.
Create one fresh immutable formal root, write admission before spawning Blender, retain every partial output on failure.
Run the independent Node auditor only after both Blender children exit successfully.

output.immutableFailurePolicy: Any failure preserves the root. Repair requires a new correction and a new root.

decision.supportedWhen: All input/runtime/tool/process bindings pass, both Blender implementations agree, CLOSE_REFLECTION satisfies the complete diagnostic signature, and neither readable control satisfies it.
decision.invalidated: A missing or mismatched input/tool/runtime, child exception, resource breach, render call, output mutation, or auditor failure yields scientificVerdict null.

nonClaims: This diagnostic does not repair any camera.
This diagnostic does not define cinematic composition or general shot quality.
This diagnostic does not authorize the full 288-frame Cycles sequence.
The later correction must freeze its own thresholds and use temporal holdout frames not consulted during camera adjustment.
Prior human labels are disclosed derivation labels, not blinded review evidence.
